0.original: Concern is writ plain upon Varshahn's face.

48.original: Even those part voidsent require rest, I imagine. And her own abode seems as good a place as any.

49.original: Unlike the Source, however, there is scant ambient aether for her to draw upon here...

50.original: In her present state, Zero is easy prey for other voidsent. We must be on our guard.

51.original: Though so slow as to be nearly imperceptible, Zero's chest rises and falls in a steady rhythm...

52.original: How long do you suppose she will remain this way?

53.original: I haven't the faintest inkling, nor can I say whether the aether we can afford to share will be enough to awaken her.

54.original: 'Twould be best to take her back with us to the Source. There, she would be guaranteed all she requires.

55.original: Zero cannot give her consent, but it seems we have no choice. The alternative would be to leave her here, defenseless.

56.original: Should she later desire it, we can bring her home.

57.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, might I ask you to hold on to Barbariccia's memoria? It may yet serve a purpose.

60.original: We have a newcomer─a former minion of Barbariccia.

61.original: Let her know when she wakes, will you?

63.original: Why not go and find this newcomer? So we have something to tell Zero, if nothing else.

65.original: May I trouble you to join me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? With luck, we might learn something of Golbez.

66.original: Worry not, we will keep an eye on Zero. Go and meet this newcomer.

67.original: When the leader falls, the minions pledge themselves to the enemy. There's no loyalty─only survival.

68.original: This appears to be the newcomer.

69.original: <gasp> Y-You're the ones who felled Barbariccia!

70.original: I-I won't make trouble. I-I'll obey. So please, let me stay!

71.original: If you would obey, then tell me all you know of Golbez.

72.original: Th-There isn't much I <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> tell. Only the archfiends are allowed into his domain, wherever it is. None but they know.

73.original: I see... No better way to guard oneself than keeping one's location secret.

74.original: How does Golbez communicate with his minions afield?

75.original: He has these...scepters? Staves? Whatever they are, he uses them to talk to those far away.

76.original: Not unlike linkpearls, at least in function...<hex:02100103>That will be all. My thanks for your cooperation.

77.original: My thanks to you as well for affording me the time.

78.original: I am satisfied, so let us rejoin the others and head home.

79.original: Vrtra has told all. Golbez goes to great lengths indeed to conceal his whereabouts.

80.original: While I'm sure Nahbdeen has matters under control, I can't help but worry. Let's not keep them waiting.

81.original: Whenever Barbariccia moved her domain, some would get left behind. No such worries here.

82.original: I trust you understand that once we leave the Thirteenth, we will not return until we are prepared to resume our search. Knowing this, are you ready to depart?

83.original: You will not be able to freely return to the Thirteenth. Are you certain you wish to leave?

84.original: Back to Troia, then, and thence home...

86.original: <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, we have been expecting you. If you would follow me, I will show you to the guest chambers.

87.original: Proceed to the Meghaduta guest chambers?
